contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ [LAETITIA AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Postumus (260-269), pierced with slit at 12 O.clock obverse; traces of silver wash. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Galley travelling left. Reverse inscription: [LAETITIA AVG]. Diameter: 21.2mm, Weight: 2.48gms, die axis: 12
